text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only a non-flammable, non-toxic product. Burn off paint outdoors first.

svg.text: Air ports: four, 40 wide x 110 tall, bottom edge 20 mm above the floor,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the four diagonals (front left, front right, back left, back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right; the tap is on the right). Drill the corners 6 mm, cut

svg.text: between with an angle grinder and thin disc, file the edges.
